items.title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker — attackers now run fully autonomous exploit agents
items.summary: Google's quarterly AI threat report says fully automated patch-to-exploit attacks are now happening in the wild.

items.title: Ask Maps — itineraries, route tips and appointment booking
items.summary: Google's Ask Maps now plans trips, warns about route details and books local appointments.

items.title: US remote-access chip rule — overseas data centers need a license to serve China
items.summary: Renting US AI chips through a data center abroad now needs the same license as buying them, if the customer is Chinese.

items.title: SkillEvaluator 0.9 — NVIDIA's agent-skill tester adds budgets and version diffs
items.summary: SkillEvaluator 0.9 runs your agent with and without a skill, then shows if the skill helped and what the run cost.

items.title: Apple Health AI Usage Study — an OpenEvidence app for 200,000 iPhone users
items.summary: Apple tests how people trust and use AI health answers, with a study app built on OpenEvidence.

items.title: LoopForge — Tencent's self-hosted workflows for coding agents
items.summary: Tencent's open-source workspace turns a team's delivery process into agent workflows with human sign-off.

items.title: RUMOR — FT: Jensen Huang weighs a return as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: FT sources say ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is weighing a comeback, backed by a lobbying 'war room'.

items.title: Steve Blank: What's Next for Nvidia? — Visionary CEO or operator
items.summary: Steve Blank looks at Nvidia's CEO search through the history of Microsoft and Apple.

items.title: Qwen4-Max — Alibaba's Qwen4 flagship is live on the API at $1.50 / $4.50
items.summary: Alibaba's first full Qwen4 model goes live on the API, cheaper than the Qwen3.8-Max it replaces.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra and the Standard Model — a candidate lattice definition
items.summary: A physicist credits OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra with leading the proof behind a proposed lattice version of the Standard Model.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'Claude just changed EVERYTHING...'
items.summary: Wes Roth walks through Anthropic's recent Claude changes and what they say about the company before its IPO.

items.title: Sebastian Raschka — understanding positional embeddings in modern LLMs
items.summary: Sebastian Raschka walks through how LLMs know where each token sits, with RoPE explained step by step in PyTorch.

items.title: Haru-4B — an open speech model that listens and talks at the same time
items.summary: An Apache-2.0 voice model that talks like a phone call: it listens while it speaks instead of waiting for its turn.

items.title: Jakub T. Jankiewicz — all AI-generated code should be open source
items.summary: A developer argues that code written by AI belongs to everyone, because AI learned it from everyone.

items.title: DeepSeek App API — web search, file input and safety checks built into the API
items.summary: DeepSeek moves the tools behind its chat app into the API, so developers can rebuild the app with a few request flags.

items.title: Nathan Lambert — Jensen Huang's exit is a setback for US open models
items.summary: Interconnects' Nathan Lambert says Huang was the open-model ecosystem's protector, and that support will likely fade.

items.title: Chrome DevTools MCP 1.13.0 — logpoints and network mocks for coding agents
items.summary: Chrome DevTools MCP 1.13.0 lets an agent add logging to a running page and fake its network responses, without editing the site's code.

items.title: deepseek-v3-jax — DeepSeek V3 in 190 lines of pure JAX
items.summary: deepseek-v3-jax rebuilds DeepSeek V3's key ideas in 190 lines of plain JAX that you can read in one sitting.

items.title: Plannotator — review your coding agent's plans and diffs in a browser
items.summary: Plannotator gives coding agents a browser review screen, so you mark up a plan or diff instead of arguing in chat.

items.title: WSJ: Nvidia backed buyers' loans — so they could keep buying its GPUs
items.summary: A WSJ report says Nvidia guaranteed its customers' loans so they could keep buying Nvidia GPUs.

items.title: EFF — AI wearables turn privacy into a problem for everyone nearby
items.summary: The EFF says always-on AI recording devices take away the privacy choices of everyone around the wearer.

items.title: No AI Slop Manifesto — AI engineers pledge to own what their agents ship
items.summary: A pledge from AI engineers: agents are useful, but passing on unreviewed output is slop.

items.title: Apple App Review — AI-made apps slow down music developers
items.summary: Vibe-coded apps are flooding the iOS music category, and established developers say App Review is stuck.

items.title: Antigravity /teamwork — Google's agent teams prove an open math conjecture
items.summary: Google Research reports what Antigravity's multi-agent /teamwork system has solved, and opens free access for 10,000 academics.

items.title: Claude outage — login failures, then API errors hit claude.ai and Claude Code
items.summary: Two back-to-back Claude incidents on 13 November locked users out, then broke the API and connectors.
